prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D illustration for the story intro of an underground survival game, wide 16:9 composition. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no text.
Use case: style-transfer. Edit reference scene 6 into EXTREMELY SIMPLE FLAT GRAPHIC INDIE STORY ART. Preserve the scene composition and narrative, reduce every element to rounded or angular filled shapes with thick dark-brown outlines. Exactly seven broad colour families, no rendered texture. REMOVE 95 percent of small details: no rock cracks, no fabric weave, no realistic mountain rendering, no realistic fur, no realistic facial anatomy. Mountains and cave walls are a few smooth broad colour slabs. Characters are short round sturdy 2.5-head-tall little people with dot eyes and mitten hands, scalloped fur with at most 3 inner tufts. Broad completely plain colour areas as in Hilda animation. Depth only by overlapping flat planes, never shading. No gradients. Keep bottom fifth calm. Top third remains empty dark blue for separate title. Keep full 16:9 frame, no borders.
